title: astra.registry.plugin/1
description: plugins/<id>/plugin.json — the version-independent half of a listing. Hand-written, hand-reviewed, one file per plugin. Everything that changes per release lives in versions/<semver>.json instead, so a new release is a new file and never a conflicting edit.

id.description: Must equal the containing directory name. Becomes a path component on every user's disk — tools/lib/ids.mjs checks far more than this pattern.

icon.$comment: A FILENAME beside this document, not a URL. The bytes are committed to the registry so a reviewer sees the actual picture in the pull request diff instead of a base64 blob, and tools/build-index.mjs inlines them into the signed index as a data: URI. Extracted from the attested bundle by bot/ingest.mjs. Takes precedence over `icon_url`, which names a host the plugin author controls and so makes rendering the store a request to a third party once per listing per refresh.

readme.$comment: Likewise a filename beside this document. Markdown, sanitised when it was derived: no raw HTML, and every image either pinned to the attested commit or dropped to its alt text. bot/lib/assets.mjs says what is removed and why.

added_at.description: The day this plugin was first listed. A date, not a timestamp: it is provenance, not telemetry.

unlisted.description: true keeps the listing in git and out of the generated index. Used to retire a plugin without deleting its audit trail.

source.description: Where the bytes come from. The daemon re-derives the expected download URL from this and refuses an artifact URL that does not sit under it (PRODUCTION_PLAN §5.3 A.6), so this field is a security control, not a link.
